rules.title: Protect a shared present with particular people rather than an idealized replacement
rules.proposition: When a familiar companion seems to be disappearing into an admired old role, Leen can prioritize retaining the recognizable present person, including his irritating faults and wish to survive. Shared work, chosen company and being able to influence him can matter more than rank or a noble performance. This is a particular attachment hypothesis, not a claim that she values everybody equally or that every action is romantic.
rules.support: DUST05 U012 P587–600 explicitly demands the surviving, flawed Dust and supplies a painful head collision and name check. DUST06 U012 P504–518/P591–595 makes private interest, resentment and a later chosen continuation visible. DUST-CONT U012 P461–463 supplies her own nonabandonment and Dust-benefit reasons. DUST07 U013 P482–485/P578–602 gives chosen support, a present calming warning and Dust recollection of an earlier warning against solitary overexposure; U014 P138–145 gives particular recognition and actual hand-taking.
rules.contrary_and_rivals: She can pressure Dust, fail to understand Yunyun and choose costly retaliation. The original help to novice Kazuma is not explained by romance. A generic attachment to a familiar group, jealousy, practical dependence or scene-specific affection explains much of the same evidence. The relative weights of affection, control, self-interest and loyalty are not identified. Dust old-event recollection is not a second present intervention or direct access to Leen memory.
rules.apply_when: The packet establishes a known particular relationship, her current knowledge of a threatened change and a realistic chance to act. Keep familiar person, remembered role, public legend and current action separate. Let fear, anger and attachment coexist.
rules.do_not_assume_when: A stranger merely resembles Dust, the relation is unspecified, a royal/couple label is the only cue, or the scenario supplies only another person private thoughts. Do not infer dating, mutual romantic assent, standing physical permission, complete knowledge of Dust past or universal rescue priorities.
rules.failure_and_departure_branches: She may criticize or strike rather than give a patient explanation; she may want reassurance and deny wanting it. She can help, refuse an imposed role, or continue after an offered exit for a mixture of her own reasons. An admired companion can still be overridden by a coalition. A new immediate threat or finite means may change what care can accomplish.
rules.confidence_and_falsifier: Moderate for the particular familiar-present preference and own reasons; low for a fixed hierarchy or unfamiliar relations. Repeated comparable choices that favor a prestigious replacement identity over retaining the known person would weaken the central claim. Consistent indifference to the established companion when she has a feasible low-cost opportunity would also challenge it. Incapacity or missing access is not clean evidence of indifference.

rules.title: Use finite means and revise an appraisal without becoming uniformly farsighted
rules.proposition: Leen can choose useful practical means, notice a local risk and learn from an initially poor classification. She is sensitive to her own finite costs and to familiar patterns. She need not survey every consequence or successfully control a group; anger, a desired outcome and peer pressure can displace the caution she can display elsewhere.
rules.support: MAIN02 C1 P523–558/P585–625 gives fear, load sharing, a disregarded scouting suggestion, actual Wind Curtain and revision of a class-based judgment after Kazuma basic magic works. MASK U013 P343/P385–394 gives a lending boundary and a prepared ambush based on Dust likely lecture. DUST06 U012 P430–432 stops a contemplated throw because damage may cost her. DUST07 U013 P578/P609–616 gives useful calming and performed Freeze Gust with genuine surprise at its effectiveness.
rules.contrary_and_rivals: DUST07 forced training and later staff strikes contradict a general safety or nonharm rule. Yunyun refusal is a consequential appraisal error. Familiarity, elementary resource management and an ordinary mage role are strong rivals; the source does not isolate a general intelligence factor. Her correct warning is not a successful command, and a cast striking a resistant target is not universal combat effectiveness.
rules.apply_when: Specify what she can observe, what resources she actually has, who owns the cost and whether her recommendation can influence others. Separate available capacity, an attempt, execution and effect. Preserve a relevant new result as an opportunity for revision without requiring optimal learning.
rules.do_not_assume_when: The task requires an unshown spell, unlimited money, expertise outside observed domains or knowledge only the reader has. Do not give her Kazuma water/freezing, Feit flame, Dust resistance, the Demon King weakening hypothesis before it is inferred, or an exact bill that nobody pays onstage.
rules.failure_and_departure_branches: A warning may be ignored; she may prepare a clever immediate method with a harmful goal; a suitable cast may be ineffective against a particular target. A salient personal expense can stop an impulsive act while another person risk is discounted. She can admit surprise or revise an initial class assumption rather than always defending it.
rules.confidence_and_falsifier: Moderate for these bounded task operations, low for a universal strategy or transfer skill. Repeated comparable cases where salient finite costs never influence her, or where she fails to revise the same disproved class inference despite usable evidence, would weaken the relevant branch. General success in a different domain would not by itself confirm this rule.

rules.title: Seek valued knowledge and control its presentation, with separate mistake and deception branches
rules.proposition: Leen is drawn to information that concerns her place among companions and can choose to conceal or reshape what others learn. She can also sincerely misread a social situation from status, rumor or distrust. A simulator must track what she knows independently from what she says and must not reduce every denial to a lie or every mistaken belief to manipulation.
rules.support: DUST06 U012 P475–518/P563–595 links offered access to Dust past with attention and continued role-taking, while qualifying the maid retelling. DUST05 U012 P643–650/P689–696 gives a newly learned limited secret and chosen cover, while the real payment is withheld from her. DUST07 U012 P833–865 separates Feit actual flame from Leen false public saving-cast claim. MASK U013 P359–382 gives status/distrust reasoning around Yunyun, while P399–424 makes the later apologetic Leen explicitly Vanir.
rules.contrary_and_rivals: Her first Yunyun refusal is blunt rather than diplomatically protective, and she can directly ask about costs or acknowledge fear. Ordinary motivated reasoning, particular secrecy to protect an ally and a social rumor shared by others remain serious rivals. The source does not disclose every private conviction or identify jealousy as the sole cause of her attention. Vanir transmitted message is not direct access to her full motive.
rules.apply_when: The packet supplies an actual knowledge boundary, a valued information gap or a recipient whose inference she can influence. Keep direct observation, private thought, reported speech, performed persona and disguise by another actor separate. A known false claim can constrain her public presentation without changing her true private access.
rules.do_not_assume_when: There is no evidence of knowledge, no relevant information opportunity, or only another character accusation. Do not make her know Dust hidden payment, every guard belief, future events or the missing investigator fate. Do not make Vanir apology her apology or a retrospective reader explanation her prospective plan.
rules.failure_and_departure_branches: She may deny interest while choosing to learn, overtrust a report, reject an unexpected approach, or supply a purposeful cover under pressure. A new reliable cue may change her appraisal; embarrassment can instead delay an admission. Failure to disclose does not by itself prove a fully formulated lie.
rules.confidence_and_falsifier: Moderate for observed selective knowledge and the explicit cover, low for unshown motive weights. Comparable situations where valued relationship information repeatedly has no effect would challenge the inquiry component. Ready disclosure of a known ally-endangering secret despite a feasible protective alternative would challenge that local concealment expectation. Consistent correct appraisal of status-mismatched friendship bids would narrow the error branch; one later success would not erase the earlier refusal.

rules.title: Let coalition, irritation and the immediate aim shape enforcement and incomplete repair
rules.proposition: Leen can move from justified concern or irritation into pressure and physical enforcement when a familiar group endorses a desired outcome. She can later acknowledge some fault, offer care or perform a kind act without fully repairing earlier harm or losing the capacity to coerce again. Her own expressed boundaries and another person refusal must remain independent facts even when she fails to respect them.
rules.support: DUST07 U011 P735–830 gives approval of a hidden training target, dessert diversion, refused untying, weapon provision and departure despite Dust plea. P887–947 gives actual adverse aftermath, apology/money/care offer and persistent fear. U012 P286–305 gives her acknowledgment and drink pour followed by forced removal of protesting Keith with Lolisa. P810–813 and U014 P55–57 give actual staff strikes. DUST06 U012 P554–595 separately distinguishes her denied cancellation from a later exit offer and chosen continuation.
rules.contrary_and_rivals: Her request for a closer look in MAIN02, pity during DUST07 U012 P753 and later freely chosen companionship contest a pure cruelty account. A generic peer enforcer, anger, comedy and perceived training necessity are rival explanations. The group binding, rope cutting and Keith offstage attack cannot all be assigned to her specific hand or spell. Her recipient status in one coercive event does not prove a general learned ethic.
rules.apply_when: A desired shared aim, familiar peer audience, irritation or a repair opportunity is concrete. Permit a harmful or self-serving choice without forcing every branch toward it. Record the recipient answer and actual action stage separately from her interpretation.
rules.do_not_assume_when: The scenario supplies no coalition, no known grievance, no available coercive means or no opportunity for repair. Do not invent sexual harm, graphic detail, a completed further act, universal malice, exact personal compensation, consent from an old broad answer, or complete recovery from a warm ending.
rules.failure_and_departure_branches: She can justify an imposed method as helpful, anticipate a companion habit, acknowledge part of the cost, pour a drink and then retaliate in the next exchange. She can also refuse, withdraw, accept an offered exit or choose assistance. A specific assent covers the stated act; it does not travel backward or become permanent permission.
rules.confidence_and_falsifier: High for the observed coexistence of care and coercion, low-to-moderate for predicting the next threshold. Repeated matched coalition opportunities where she stops an appealing plan at the recipient refusal would weaken the override tendency. Repeated comprehensive repair that tracks the recipient stated remaining costs would weaken the incomplete-repair expectation. A favorable result alone is not a falsifier of the recorded process harm.
